quote: As the case of cryonics testifies, the fear of thinking really different is stronger than the fear of death.
content: The comparison between skydiving and cryonics confounds everything it is meant to isolate. Skydiving costs a few hundred dollars, is enjoyable, and works; cryonics costs tens of thousands, delivers nothing observable, and depends on a technology that has never revived anyone, and when people are asked why they have not signed up, the answers are cost and disbelief that it will work, not fear of what friends will say. The essay flags its own evolutionary story as "post facto" and then uses it as the explanation anyway, which is the pattern the sequence warns against in others. The conclusion, that non-adoption of the author's preferred technology demonstrates a species-level cowardice stronger than the fear of death, treats disagreement about a factual question, whether vitrified brains preserve information, as a character defect in the disagreers.

quote: To be a scientific revolutionary, you’ve got to be the first person to contradict what everyone else you know is thinking.
content: The sociology of discovery found that the lone first contradictor is mostly a myth. Merton's study of multiples showed that a large fraction of major scientific discoveries were made independently by two or more people at about the same time, calculus, oxygen, natural selection, the telephone, and that the pattern is the norm rather than the exception (Merton 1961, "Singletons and Multiples in Scientific Discovery," Proceedings of the American Philosophical Society, no DOI). Discoveries happen when the field's accumulated knowledge makes them available, and the discoverer is the person who gets there first among several who are close. Darwin had Wallace; Einstein had Poincaré and Lorentz most of the way. The romantic picture of the revolutionary alone against the consensus is the picture the essay says rock bands fake, and the essay, which asks readers to ponder how rare scientific revolutionaries are, has adopted it. The essay's better sentence is the one that says you get there by pursuing correctness whether or not it is revolutionary; the lonely part is decoration.
